meaning: A spare copy of your files, kept in a second place. If the first copy is lost or broken, you still have the second.
clues: It is a way to protect your files.
It still works if a device is lost, broken, or stolen.
It is a spare copy of your photos, documents, and other files.
You keep it in a second place, like an external drive or online storage.
It has six letters and starts with B.
assumes: Antivirus software scans for harmful programs

decoys.meaning: Harmful software that locks your files. The crook then demands payment to unlock them.
Software that scans a device for harmful programs and removes them.
Hidden software that secretly watches what you do on a device and sends it to someone else.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: We always kept a second disk with a copy of every important file. Good habit, if I say so myself.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Still a great one. Turn on automatic backup in your phone's settings, and you never have to remember to do it.

sources.name: Apple Support, How to back up your iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch
